title: Merauke: authority, operators and beneficiaries
question: Who authorises, implements, finances and benefits from each food, energy and infrastructure project, and whose land decisions are overridden or recognised?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: AHU/deeds and shareholder histories; procurement/contract instruments; budget appropriations and actual payments; machinery finance; environmental approvals and maps; court decisions; community statements and the documented implementation of remedies.

title: Political finance, appointments and business access
question: How do Indonesian party/campaign networks and business interests intersect with decisions affecting Papua?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: full LPPDK/donor schedules and audits; dated company records; LHKPN declarations; appointment decisions; policy drafts; tender/contract records; relevant corruption proceedings and responses. No donor amount should be invented from a report of political closeness.

title: Three legs of military business
question: Through what institutional, private and informal arrangements does military/police power participate in economic activity?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: foundation/cooperative corporate histories, annual reports, formal support agreements, court findings, verified payment records, business-reform regulations and dated personnel roles.

title: Freeport: contracts, security, ownership and public revenue
question: How have mining rights, economic control, security support, revenue and land relations changed from the contract era to the current structure?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: contract/IUPK texts, transaction documents, annual/security reports, MIND ID and regional entitlement records, tax/royalty/dividend accounts, environmental monitoring, labour proceedings, original ethics hearings and court dispositions.

title: Tangguh: gas, lenders, export buyers and affected communities
question: Who finances the project, holds economic interests, buys the output and bears its land, livelihood and environmental effects?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: ADB/JBIC project documents, environmental/social assessments and monitoring, sponsor reports, debt agreements where public, offtake terms, grievance records and local testimony. A lender's participation is a financing fact; a claim of complicity requires its own evidence.

title: Plantation permits, opaque ownership and commodity buyers
question: How do permits and corporate structures turn customary forests into plantations, and where do capital and products move?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: historical company deeds, permit signatures and amendments, court records, mill/refinery links, buyer disclosures and grievance processes. A brand's indirect supply exposure differs from ownership, operational control or a direct purchase.

title: State projects, procurement and enrichment
question: Who plans, awards, builds, invoices and is paid for public projects, and what was delivered?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: SiRUP/LPSE/INAPROC records and document access where available, contract amendments, BPK/BPKP findings, beneficial ownership and litigation. Being awarded a contract is not by itself evidence of corruption; a documented irregularity needs its own record.

title: Weapons, export chains and the last mile to an incident
question: What can be established about the manufacture, transfer, procurement and actual use of weapons in specific Papua incidents?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: original tracing report/note verbale if publicly obtainable, export permits/end-user records, procurement disclosures, verified imagery and independent technical identification. A national sale to Indonesia is not proof of use in Papua. Photographs and accounts of burning do not by themselves identify a chemical agent.

title: Operations, displacement and disruption of civilian life
question: What happened in a specific campaign or incident, which actors were involved, and how did people live and organise afterward?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
source_references_as_written: S06–S07 plus existing History evidence ledgers
next_records: original Komnas HAM/ELSHAM/church inquiries, medical/service records, satellite assessments, humanitarian monitoring and follow-up accounts. Different casualty estimates and direct/indirect deaths must remain distinguishable. Do not infer an individual's command responsibility from a job title alone.

title: Detention, abduction, assassination and accountability
question: How were people targeted, what happened to inquiries and prosecutions, and which questions remain unresolved?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: See research brief for case-specific records.

title: Internet restrictions and information access
question: Who ordered or implemented communications restrictions, under what legal claims, and with what documented effects?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: original decisions, government directions, operators' disclosures, network measurements, journalists' accounts and effects on reporting, education, commerce and emergency access. Do not treat a technical outage as intentional censorship without evidence.

title: Propaganda and coordinated influence
question: Which narratives, account networks, vendors and disclosed clients shaped information about Papua?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: platform takedown disclosures, archived public posts, domain/ad transparency data, procurement and vendor responses. Technical coordination, likely operator and ultimate sponsor have different evidence requirements. Preserve material without amplifying unverified accusations or targeting ordinary private users.

title: Surveillance vendors, agencies and targeting
question: Which systems were sold or deployed, by whom, under what authority, and can particular targeting be established?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: original export/trade documents, agency procurement and forensic victim-device findings where consensually public. An export to Indonesia cannot silently become 'this tool surveilled this Papuan'.

title: Otsus, territorial administration and elite networks
question: How do changes in autonomy, provincial boundaries, appointments and spending redistribute authority and resources?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: laws and implementing instruments, court challenges, transfer/allocation data, APBD realisation, audit findings, procurement and original corruption judgments. Include Papuan officials' public choices, interests and criticisms on the same evidentiary basis as national actors.

title: Land authority, consent, women and social relations
question: Who is treated as able to consent to a land transaction, and whose use, care and authority are excluded?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: the actual agreement and signatories' roles, boundaries and collective decision processes, compensation terms, women's accounts and ecological/food knowledge. A leader's signature does not automatically establish every rights-holder's consent. Adat practices require local specificity.

title: Work, wages, strikes and company-community institutions
question: How are extraction benefits and risks distributed among workers and surrounding communities, and how are rights contested?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: employment/collective agreements, dismissal and reinstatement proceedings, benefit/health arrangements, accident investigations, social-fund governance and community representation. A social programme is not automatically consent, compensation for all harm or a corrupt payment.

title: Land change, food, water and health
question: Which changes are observed, what effects are documented, and who bears them?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: methods and underlying satellite dates, environmental/health studies, AMDAL monitoring, community knowledge, complaints and agency/company responses. Proximity or chronology alone does not establish a particular health cause. Fire detection, smoke model and health diagnosis are separate records.

title: Decolonisation, Cold War policy and resource rights
question: How did Dutch, Indonesian, US and UN decisions shape Papuan political participation and the allocation of authority?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: original telegrams and memoranda, New York Agreement and UN records, Dutch cabinet/governor archives, Papuan petitions and institutional records. A CIA analysis is not evidence of a covert operation. The CIA URL attempted in this pass returned a maintenance page, so that document is still unread. [S41]

title: Foreign military relationships and civilian functions
question: How do training, assistance, export policy and domestic military roles develop despite abuse findings and restrictions?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: government assistance/training notices, export records, enacted laws, official appointment decisions and court/inquiry outcomes. Separate a country's general relationship with Indonesia from a specific Papua incident.

title: Papuan political thought, organising, churches and cultural work
question: What futures have Papuans argued for, through which institutions and strategies, and how have those positions changed?
status: research framework; claims require case-level review
next_records: books/passages, recorded speeches and interviews, organisation statements with dates and mandates, church/community archives, cultural works and internal critiques. ULMWP, TPNPB, KNPB, OPM and smaller organisations require period-specific histories; shared goals do not establish a single command structure. Preserve Papuan perspectives and disagreements rather than treating everyone as a generic victim or organisation node.
